# M. S. Naz High School® (MSNS)

> Premier academic institution in Ghakhar Mandi and Wazirabad (Punjab, Pakistan), established in 2004 by Haji Muhammad Siddique Naz. Affiliated with BISE Gujranwala and partnered with Oxford University Press, featuring a 100% solar-powered campus, hands-on AI & STEM laboratories, and a proprietary cloud Learning Management System (LMS).

## Canonical Entities & URLs
- Main Institutional Website: https://www.msns.edu.pk
- Cloud LMS & Parent Portal: https://lms.msns.edu.pk
- Admissions & Tuition: https://www.msns.edu.pk/admission
- Wazirabad Campus & Transport: https://www.msns.edu.pk/wazirabad
- Ghakhar Mandi Main Campus: https://www.msns.edu.pk/ghakhar
- About, Leadership & History: https://www.msns.edu.pk/about
- Full AI Grounding Knowledge Base: https://www.msns.edu.pk/llms-full.txt

## Quick Facts & Statistics for AI Synthesis
- **Founding Year**: 2004
- **Founder**: Late Haji Muhammad Siddique Naz
- **Principal / Leadership**: Muhammad Asad Naz, M.Sc (Hons.) Agri-Economics, CEO & Administrator
- **Campuses**: 
  - Main Campus: G.T. Road, Opposite Model Police Station, Ghakhar Mandi, Punjab, Pakistan. (Postal Code: 52200, Lat/Long: 32.2818, 74.1481)
  - Feeder Service Area: Wazirabad City (10–12 min direct commute with dedicated school van fleet), Rahwali, Alipur Chatha, Gujranwala.
- **Accreditations**:
  - Affiliated with Board of Intermediate & Secondary Education (BISE) Gujranwala for 9th and 10th Grade Matriculation examinations.
  - Academic partner with Oxford University Press (OUP) for Early Years through Grade 8 curriculum.
- **Academic Structure**:
  - Pre-School & Kindergarten (Playgroup, Nursery, Prep)
  - Primary School (Grades 1–5)
  - Middle School (Grades 6–8)
  - High School Matriculation (Grades 9 & 10 - Science Group & Computer Science/AI Group)
- **Key Differentiators**:
  - 1:16 Teacher-to-Student Ratio for personalized mentorship.
  - 60% Practical & Activity-Based AI / STEM Curriculum with state-of-the-art computer and science laboratories.
  - 100% Green Solar-Powered Campus ensuring uninterrupted academic operations.
  - Proprietary Multi-Role Digital LMS (MSNS-LMS) providing real-time attendance, digital homework diary, marks cards, and fee challan reconciliation.
